sections.A: MS mein jism ka immune system dimagh aur spinal cord ki nerves ke hifazati gilaaf (myelin) par hamla karta hai.
sections.B: Symptoms jagah par depend karte hain: thakan (bohat aam), kamzori, spasticity, sensation ki tabdeeli, balance aur nazar ke masle.
sections.C: MS ki qism aur arsa, haal ka relapse, thakan ka pattern aur garmi se symptoms ka barhna.
sections.D: EDSS (neurologist), Timed 25-Foot Walk, balance, taaqat aur thakan ke scales.
sections.G: Bukhar ke baghair 24 ghante se zyada naye ya barhte symptoms (relapse), ya bukhar ke saath bigarna (infection): doctor ko refer.
sections.H: Relapse ho to intensity kam, kaam barqarar rakhein, theek hone ka intezaar, phir dobara assessment. Stable ho to exercise program.
sections.I: Moderate aerobic exercise (10-30 minute, hafte mein 2-3 baar), strength, balance aur thakan sambhalne ke tareeqe.
sections.M: Chalne ki raftaar aur endurance, balance, thakan scores, MSWS-12 aur goals.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Uhthoff phenomenon: jism garam hone par symptoms ka waqti tor par barhna.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
